message.subject: Re: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Mrs Fuchsreiter,

Thank you for your quick quotation for the HX pump shaft. We value the reliable cooperation between our two family companies and would like to find a fair solution for both sides.

Before we settle on a price, we have looked at a few figures:
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70250@2026Q3).
German labour costs in manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

On this basis we cannot follow the quoted price. We have prepared three genuine options instead:
We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 31.85; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 30.92; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 31.64; payment 30 days net; lead time 35 days.

The options differ in their payment terms, so you can choose the balance of price and payment speed that suits you best. We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Before we settle terms, one point matters to us for planning:

Your on-time delivery was 62.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

Dependable delivery is central to a new series, so we have structured our proposal around planning security for both sides.

Option B: unit price EUR 28.01; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 28.75; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Each option is a genuine route forward. Option A gives you a longer payment period in exchange for a sharper price. We look forward to your view.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Mrs Fuchsreiter,

Thank you for your quick quotation for the HX pump shaft. We value the reliable cooperation between our two family companies and would like to find a fair solution for both sides.

Before we settle on a price, we have looked at a few figures:
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70250@2026Q3).
German labour costs in manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

On this basis we cannot follow the quoted price. We have prepared three genuine options instead:
We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 31.85; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 30.92; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 31.64; payment 30 days net; lead time 35 days.

The options differ in their payment terms, so you can choose the balance of price and payment speed that suits you best. We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
